The '''Spider's Den''' is a [[Combat]] location unlocked after reaching {{skl|Combat|I}}.

{{ZoneText|Talk to Haymitch.|Watch out for spiders!|Try to make it to the top of the &cSpider Mound&f.|Learn about the &3Bestiary&f.}}

== Features ==
The '''Spider's Den''' can be accessed after the player has attained {{skl|Combat|I}} by using a [[Launch Pad|Launchpad]] found in the back of the [[Graveyard]]. It can also be accessed with the [[Portals|Portal to The Spider's Den]] or [[Travel Scrolls|Travel Scroll to the Spider's Den]]. This will take the player to a different sub-server containing The Spiders Den.

The Spider's Den has multiple sub-regions: The {{Zone|Spider Mound}} with multiple chasms and stairs containing weaker mobs, {{Zone|Grandma's House}} containing multiple [[NPC]]s, the {{Zone|Gravel Mines}}, and {{Zone|Arachne's Burrow}}, {{Zone|Archaeologist's Camp}} with [[Archaeologist]] and {{Zone|Arachne's Sanctuary}} containing stronger versions of the spiders found in the den (This is where you can find the [[Arachne]] boss). The spiders get stronger in deeper regions of the cave. These enemies include:

*[[Dasher Spider]]s, which dash towards players.
*[[Splitter Spider]]s, which spawn silverfish upon death.
*[[Weaver Spider]]s, which shoot cobweb at the players.
*[[Voracious Spider]]s, which have significantly higher health and damage than other spiders.
*[[Spider Jockey]]s, which have a [[Jockey Skeleton]] on their back.

In {{Zone|Arachne's Burrow}}, all spiders have a chance to drop an [[Arachne's Calling]], which can be used to summon the boss [[Arachne]], which has two versions depending on how she's summoned.

On the outskirts of the islands, one may also find [[Rain Slime]]s, [[Toxic Rain Slime]]s and [[Flint Skeleton]]s, with the former spawning on the road between {{Zone|Arachne's Burrow}} and the Spiders Den during rain while the latter spawns near the gravel pit.

Every {{Green|40}} minutes on the {{zone|Spider's Den}}, {{Green|20}} minutes of [[Weather#Rain|Rain]] begins. While raining, players gain {{Stat|fs|+25}} and {{MobSprite|Rain Slime}}s spawn. After raining twice, the third rain becomes a thunderstorm and in addition to previous effects {{MobSprite|Toxic Rain Slime}}s start to spawn.

=== Tiny Island ===
[[File:Tiny Island.png|thumb|x200px]]
The Tiny Island is a feature located in between [[The End]] and the Spiders Den. It can be accessed by a [[Barrier]] bridge. The island's purpose is to house a single [[Fairy Souls|Fairy Soul]].

The navigation shown should be followed with your character facing North, while not changing your point of view! Hold down {{Key|Shift}} to avoid falling off.

Alternatively, player can navigate by looking for borders of invisible blocks that appear when block is pointed at with the crosshair.

It is also possible to use an [[Aspect of the End]] or [[Grappling Hook]] and get there although it may be quite difficult.

== Trivia ==
*The skeleton of the dragon is revealed to be the {{Color|dark_purple|Chozon}}, one of the generals of the Great Dragon, {{Color|Dark_purple|Jythar}} who lies next to {{zone|The Bastion}}, on the {{zone|Crimson Isle}}.
**{{NPCSprite|Corm}} (on the {{zone|Crimson Isle}}) reveals this in their [[Corm#Dialogue|dialogue]].
*While the '''Spider's Den''' applies the Mining Fatigue effect to the player, the {{Item|Gravel}} is not affected by {{stat|Mining Speed}}, instead it emulates vanilla mining behavior.
